definitions.gloss: B.C., before the Common Era, BCE
definitions.explanation: The period before the year 1 in the Western calendar system. Used with year numbers to indicate dates before the Common Era.

examples.japanese: {紀元前|きげんぜん}3⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧だ。
examples.english: These are ruins from the 3rd century B.C.

examples.japanese: エジプト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|だい}⟦ピラミッド→ピラミッド：11280_piramiddo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紀元前|きげんぜん}2500⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The Great Pyramid of Egypt was built around 2500 B.C.

examples.japanese: {紀元前|きげんぜん}5⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アテネ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{民主|みんしゅ}→民主：06028_minshu⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発展|はってん}していた→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: In 5th century B.C. Athens, democracy was flourishing.

notes:
USAGE:
Always placed before the year number: {紀元前|きげんぜん}○○⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧. This is the opposite of English word order ("500 B.C." → {紀元前|きげんぜん}500⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧). Abbreviated as B.C. in English or sometimes written as ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧○○⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ in shorthand.

FORMS:
⟦{紀元|きげん}→紀元：13822_kigen⟧ (era/epoch) + ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before) — literally "before the era."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}○○⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: ○○ B.C.
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}○⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧: ○th century B.C.
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{紀元後|きげんご}⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧: from B.C. to A.D.
